{{Quote|Master Mungo, a Gulper approaches.|C-3PO, to Mungo Baobab|<ref name="TGH" />}}
The '''Gulper''' was a circular type of rolling [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and [[Color/Legends|black]] and blue plating. A Gulper guarded the<ref name="TGH" /> [[Abominor]]<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Great Heep]]'s [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Biitu]]<ref name="TGH" /> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="15BBY">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> After the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] escaped one of the operation's mines, a Gulper pursued the droid. C-3PO alerted the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] that the Gulper was approaching their location, prompting Baobab to shoot [[Water/Legends|water]] at the Gulper, which then rolled back into the mine.<ref name="TGH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gulper appeared in ''[[The Great Heep]]'', a TV special of the [[Nelvana]] animated series [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] which was first broadcast on [[June 7]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider32">{{InsiderCite|32|Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television|''Caravan of Courage'': ''Star Wars'' on Television}}</ref>
